name: Parameters.smul_eq_iff_exists_frobElem_pow
summary: v • w = c⁻¹(w) means that galOfPlace(P, s)(v)∘c⁻¹ preserves w and so induces an automorphism of the finite residue field, a power of Frobenius; conversely a Frobenius congruence galOfPlace(P, s)(v)(x) ≡ c(x)^{p^n} mod w gives the equality of places.

steps.claim: The residue ring 𝓞_E/w has characteristic p (as p ∈ w).

(⇒) If v • w = c⁻¹(w), then x ↦ galOfPlace(P, s)(v)(c⁻¹(x)) maps w into w and induces a ring automorphism of the finite field 𝓞_E/w, linear over ℤ/p; such an automorphism is a power of Frobenius (`bijective_frobeniusAlgHom_pow`): for some n, galOfPlace(P, s)(v)(c⁻¹ y) ≡ y^{p^n} mod w for all y, i.e. φ(galOfPlace(P, s)(v) x) = φ(c x)^{p^n} for the reduction φ mod w. By `frob_iff_eq_frobElem_pow` (the residue field is a domain), (v, e) = frobElem(P, s, p)^n.
steps.lean:
⟨fun H ↦ by
    exact ((bijective_frobeniusAlgHom_pow (ZMod p) _).2 (.mk' (quotientMap _ ((galOfPlaceInt v).comp
      c.symm) ((reindex_equiv c).1.2 (by simpa using! congr($H.1).ge))) (ZMod.map_smul _))).rec fun
      n e ↦ ⟨n, (frob_iff_eq_frobElem_pow _ n he hc).1 fun x ↦ by simpa using congr($e.symm (c x))⟩,

steps.claim: (⇐) Given n with (v, e) = frobElem(P, s, p)^n, compare, for each x ∈ 𝓞_E, x ∈ v • w with x ∈ c⁻¹(w).
steps.lean:
fun ⟨n, H⟩ ↦ by ext; show _ ↔ c _ ∈ w.1; simp [← @Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem _ _ w.1,
    (frob_iff_eq_frobElem_pow _ n he hc).2 H]⟩

steps.claim: By `frob_iff_eq_frobElem_pow` for the reduction mod w, galOfPlace(P, s)(v)(x) ≡ c(x)^{p^n} mod w for all x; so x ∈ v • w ⟺ galOfPlace(P, s)(v)(x) ∈ w ⟺ c(x)^{p^n} ∈ w ⟺ c(x) ∈ w (w is prime).
steps.lean:
simp [← @Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem _ _ w.1,
    (frob_iff_eq_frobElem_pow _ n he hc).2 H]⟩
